story:
Ethan went to the park carrying his favorite blue toy rocket. [emotion:QT/happy] He was excited because he had been saving it for the perfect sunny afternoon.

Near the big oak tree, Ethan saw a boy named Marcus sitting alone. [emotion:QT/afraid] Marcus looked worried, holding two broken pieces of a toy spaceship.

[emotion:QT/sad] "I dropped it," Marcus said quietly, "and now it won't stay together.[emotion:QT/calm] "

Ethan sat beside Marcus and looked carefully at the small, cracked pieces. "My rocket has a round connector piece," Ethan said slowly, "and I think it might fit yours.[gesture:think] "

While Marcus held the broken pieces still, Ethan pressed the round connector between them. [emotion:QT/surprised] The ship clicked together perfectly, like two puzzle pieces finding each other.

[gesture:clapping] [emotion:QT/happy] "It worked!" Marcus laughed, and both boys launched their ships through the warm, golden air together.

[emotion:QT/happy] Ethan felt something bright and warm growing inside his chest — he had found a new friend.

questions.question: What was the main idea of the story about the game heroes?
questions.correct_answer: A boy who helped a new friend fix his toy.
wrong_answers: A boy who lost his favorite toy rocket.
Two boys who were playing a video game.

questions.question: Why was Marcus looking worried near the big oak tree?
questions.correct_answer: His toy spaceship was broken into pieces.
wrong_answers: He was waiting for a superhero friend.
He did not have his favorite blue rocket.

questions.question: What did Ethan do while Marcus held the broken spaceship pieces?
questions.correct_answer: He pressed a round connector between them.
wrong_answers: He gave Marcus his blue toy rocket.
He told Marcus to buy a new spaceship.

questions.question: How do you think Ethan felt when he found a new friend?
questions.correct_answer: He felt happy and warm inside.
wrong_answers: He felt sad because he lost his rocket.
He felt tired from playing a game.

questions.question: What do you think would have happened if Ethan had not helped Marcus fix his spaceship?
questions.correct_answer: They might not have become friends.
wrong_answers: Marcus would have bought a new game vehicle.
Ethan would have gone home early.

questions.question: What did Marcus show us by telling Ethan about his broken spaceship?
questions.correct_answer: Asking for help gives others a chance to be kind to you.
wrong_answers: It's important to always carry extra parts for your toys.
You should only play with toys that are very strong and won't break.

questions.question: What can you learn from how Ethan and Marcus worked together to fix the spaceship?
questions.correct_answer: Working together can fix things that seem broken at first.
wrong_answers: It's always best to try to fix things by yourself first.
New toys are always better than trying to fix old ones.

takeaways: Asking for help gives others a chance to be kind to you.
Working together can fix things that seem broken at first.
Being a good friend means sharing what you have.
